documents.title: Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.
Fixation Of Book Closure Dates For The 41St AGM

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, achieving an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and PAT of 20 crores, aided by higher margins during supply disruptions in April and May. Management noted that sourcing has normalized since June, leading to a projected volume growth of 12% to 15% and an EBITDA margin of 5% to 5.5% for the full year. The company is progressing with its corporate restructuring involving Tieramet Limited and plans a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28 while targeting 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30. Bhagyanagar India Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial performance with revenue increasing by 45.20% year-on-year to Rs. 70,507.54 lakhs and PAT growing by 167.38% to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: Management projects to maintain EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Management estimates export contribution to be between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30 regardless of copper prices.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management is aiming for 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management is expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is projected to double in the next 5 years from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: India is one of the fastest-growing copper users, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market is estimated to grow in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the copper growth will mainly be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that short lead time material from the Gulf has suddenly dried up and shipping lines have been diverted.
demand_outlook.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

capex_expansion.claim: The management proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next two financial years, FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: A capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for next financial year between April and June.
capex_expansion.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion is underway at the 60-acre integrated manufacturing facility in Hyderabad.
Management is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin at 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: Disruptions in the first two months created shortages, allowing the company to get better realizations and increase margins.
margins_costs.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

margins_costs.claim: Purchases of raw materials range from 86% to 95% of LME depending on scrap quality.
margins_costs.quote: So, our purchases would range from, you know, 86% to 95% of LME, depending on the quality of the scrap and our sales are also more or less linked to LME.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 5.43% for Q1 FY27.
Management reported an operational EBITDA of over 100 crores and PAT crossing 50 crores for the first time.
margins_costs.quote: For the first time in our history, we've also got an operational EBITDA of over 100 crores, and for the first time, we have crossed 50 crores in PAT.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that Q3 and Q4 achieved around 5% EBITDA, and 2.2% and 2.5% of PAT.
margins_costs.quote: In Q3 and Q4: e We’ve achieved around 5% EBITDA, and 2.2% and 2.5% of PAT.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that in quarter four, they achieved around 62 rupees per kg of EBITDA.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes with the new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: Total fund raise via preferential allotment is Rs. 52.25 crores.
Management stated working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST input credit reversal case of 17-18 crores was applied due to the retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, after some period of time, the registration of the supplier was cancelled with retrospective effect. And there is a particular provision in GST which says that if the supplier does not pay GST, we cannot claim the credit.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sales volumes dropped to 5,278 tons, representing a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and 6.5% from last year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that sourcing from Gulf and transshipments around the Gulf have been impacted due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is some effect of the war, but in terms of availability, the industry is affected much more than we are.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a complete digital transformation of every process, department, and reporting over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The management proposed to execute 40 crores of capex in FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are aiming to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated their target is 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they hope to reach about 7-10% in the data center sectors in the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: going forward, in the next 3 to 5 years, we hope to reach about 7-10% in the sectors.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they hope to raise funds of roughly about 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
